narr: A cold front sparked off heavy thunderstorms that slowly moved though northeast New Jersey and the NYC metro area. These thunderstorms dropped between 1.5 and 2.5 inches of rain in less than 2 hours which resulted in areas of flash flooding.
ev: The intersection of Oradell Ave and Elm Street is closed due to flooding.
Two underpasses in Allendale NJ are closed due to 2 feet of water. West Crescent Ave and West Orchard Street underpasses.
